title: Export damaged by a spreadsheet: phone numbers in scientific notation
question: Some users report they get no verification code even after several retries. Is there an issue?

expected.notes: Most recipient number values in the export were re-saved by a spreadsheet and look like 4.57E+11. The report flags this, says dial-code and number-shape checks are unreliable, does not name a cause from them, and asks for a fresh CSV export.
